notes.title: Version 1.1 is out!
notes.notes:
Version 1.1 of Follow The Cat is out now!

Here, important points to mention are on below:

-FOV added
-Gameplay precision
-Bugs
-Motion blur removed
-Player character more accurate
-Level improvements


If you encounter any issues, please post on our Steam Forums, where I’ll be tracking bugs and doing my best to issue fixes as soon as possible.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1725480/Follow_The_Cat/

notes.title: Quality Update to Version 1.1
notes.notes:
Hi everyone this update significantly improve gameplay quality of game. Please be sure have version 1.1 of game.

-Gameplay precision update
-FOV added

If you experience any additional issues, or have suggestions for me, please let me know in the Discussion Forums, or feel free to contact me via twitter: https://twitter.com/OrangeCinar

Thank you, and have a lovely weekend!

notes.notes:
It’s finally happened - [b]Follow The Cat[/b] is available on Steam today. I really happy to say that, and I really hope you’ll enjoy game as much as I enjoyed making it.

If you encounter any issues, please post on our Steam Forums, where I’ll be tracking bugs and doing my best to issue fixes as soon as possible.
